ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (21) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Совершенство» (sovershenstvo, 'perfection') and «совершенствование» (sovershenstvovaniye, 'perfecting') keep their shared root, and «представление» (predstavleniye, 'idea, conception') is 'idea' throughout. The Gospel saying is translated from Tolstoy's shortened Russian with lowercase 'father' as printed, not from a familiar Bible version.
Source observation: [14] The line opens with «Будьте» inside an opening guillemet but has no closing guillemet; the quotation is closed in the English.
